title: Orientation and newspaper habit
metric: One-page syllabus and pattern map from the official CSE notice; 60-day newspaper streak at 30+ min/day (max 3 missed days); 10-year Prelims PYQ topic-wise count sheet

title: NCERT baseline
metric: At least 90% of chapters in the mentor-approved NCERT list read with one-page notes each (list pending: data request D03)

title: Static pass 1
metric: Six core books read once (Polity, Modern History, Art and Culture, Economy, Geography, Environment); at least 20 subject-wise PYQs per subject at 60%+ accuracy

title: Optional subject lock-in
window: EE: Sem 4 end to Sem 5; MME: Sem 5 to Sem 6
metric: Up to 3 optionals compared against the official syllabus and optional_catalog.csv; at least 3 optional PYQ papers read; one optional logged; elective plan mapped to it

title: Current affairs system
metric: 90 consecutive days at 45+ min/day (max 3 missed); at least 3 monthly compilations mapped to syllabus topics

title: Answer writing foundation
metric: 30 timed answers (at least 5 per GS paper); 5 ethics case studies; 2 essays; each rated by mentor or peer on a 5-point rubric, average 3 or higher; word limits and time per answer taken from the instructions printed on UPSC PYQ papers

title: Summer intensive (post Sem 6)
window: Break after Sem 6 (Spring end-sem to Autumn start; 8-week industrial training also falls here)
metric: At least 200 logged hours (120 if on industrial training); 10 timed CSAT papers averaging 90+/200 (qualifying mark is 33%); optional Paper 1 first pass; static pass 1 gaps closed

title: Revision pass 2 and sectional tests
metric: Pass 2 of Polity, Economy, Geography, Environment; 20 sectional tests averaging 60%+; 60 cumulative answers; CA streak at least 85% of days

title: Prelims mock phase and attempt decision
window: Sem 8: classes start to about 14 days before end-sem (calendar-driven)
metric: 25 full-length GS mocks and 10 CSAT mocks each with an error-log entry; GS mock average at or above (max of last 3 verified General GS-I cut-offs) plus buffer_marks; CSAT mock average at or above 90/200; attempt decision confirmed (rule R7)

title: Compressed static sprint (late starters)
window: Sem 7 or Sem 8; only via rule R8 with 15+ hrs/week
metric: Static pass 1 of Polity, Economy, Geography, Environment, Modern History in at most 12 weeks; at least 20 PYQs per subject at 60%+; then joins upsc_prelims_mock_phase
